issues.description: STTv2 class duplicates STT instead of being an option on the existing type
issues.detail: A new class name encodes a version into the type system. The value (which model, which protocol) is being complected with the class identity. A single STT taking model_id='scribe_v2_realtime' would let the data choose the path. EASY-NOT-SIMPLE: 'follow Deepgram's pattern' is familiar but propagates a versioning mistake.

issues.description: _speaking mutable flag complects identity, value, and time in the stream
issues.detail: self._speaking is place-oriented state that the event-dispatch logic reads and writes from multiple branches. The same condition (`if not self._speaking`) is duplicated in two message handlers. Pull a small pure function `transitions(prev_state, message) -> (next_state, events)` and let _run apply it. PLACE-ORIENTED, COMPLECTED.

issues.description: Empty-text overload of committed_transcript conflates two facts on one wire signal
issues.detail: An empty committed_transcript means 'end of segment'. That is a different fact than 'final text arrived', encoded by the absence of a value. Make end-of-segment its own event in the parsed value, or model the protocol as a tagged union. The current code carries the ambiguity into the event channel.

issues.description: Audio format is derived by string formatting from sample_rate with no validation
issues.detail: `audio_format = f'pcm_{sample_rate}'` then cast to a Literal type. The Literal is decoration; any int passes. The valid set is small and known. Validate against the STTAudioFormat members, or take audio_format as input and derive sample_rate from it. One source of truth, checked once. INCIDENTAL-COMPLEXITY.

issues.description: URL is built by string concatenation rather than as data
issues.detail: Query params are accumulated as a list of f-strings then joined. Build a dict of params, drop the None entries, and let aiohttp/urlencode serialize. The value (parameters) and the wire form (query string) are different concerns; keeping them as data until the edge avoids quoting bugs and makes the option set inspectable.

issues.description: NotGivenOr+is_given wrapping for every optional re-implements Optional with ceremony
issues.detail: Each option is taken as NotGivenOr, then unwrapped to None on assignment. The end value is just `T | None`. The sentinel is incidental to this constructor; it carries no information once stored. Default to None at the signature and store directly. Less code, same behavior. INCIDENTAL-COMPLEXITY.

review.summary: The protocol-handling core is reasonable, but the design carries two pieces of incidental complexity worth naming. First, versioning is encoded in the type system (STTv2, SpeechStreamv2) rather than as data on a single STT — this is the Deepgram pattern repeated, easy but not simple. Second, the stream's event dispatch complects a mutable _speaking flag with branch-specific text inspection and an overloaded empty-string-means-end-of-segment signal; a small pure transition function over parsed messages would separate value, identity, and time. The URL builder and the NotGivenOr ceremony are smaller instances of the same theme: keep options as data, validate once at the edge, and let the wire format be derived. The question that should have been asked first: do we need a new class, or a new value passed to the existing one?
